verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a Resolution Center dashboard to "view, monitor, and manually respond to disputes" and a Disputes API to automate dispute management actions, which covers responding to and tracking disputes. The agent toolkit adds list_disputes, get_dispute and accept_dispute_claim. Nothing in the pack shows how structured evidence is submitted or how lifecycle stages and outcomes are modeled, so the evidence half of the story rests on generic claims. Missing for 10: documented structured evidence submission (evidence types, file uploads, provide-evidence endpoint), explicit dispute lifecycle states and dispute-specific webhook events, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the response workflow.
